messages.subject: Plotting categorical covariates prediction
parts:
Hi unmarked users.
I am seeking advice on some rather simple (but hard for me) topics.
I have successfully used pcount to show the influence that waterbody type has on a species am investigating. (My code is attached.)

My challenge now is to try and plot function curves to show the observed and the expected.... I hope that t is possible.
I have read through several postings on this page and found some helpful codes that I tried (see below), but my graph is blank as attached too

# Expected abundance over range of "waterbody" 
newData3c <- data.frame(waterbody=seq(-4, 4, by=0.1)) 
E.psi <- predict(model3c, type="state", newdata=newData3c, appendData=TRUE) 
head(E.psi) 

# Plot predictions with 95% CI 
plot(Predicted ~ waterbody, E.psi, type="l", ylim=c(0,1), 
     xlab="waterbody", 
     ylab="Expected occupancy probability") 
lines(lower ~ waterbody, E.psi, type="l", col=gray(0.5)) 
lines(upper ~ waterbody, E.psi, type="l", col=gray(0.5))



What can I do? 
Please advise.
Thanks,
Carol
